description: 能力中心 SQL 配置文件 - 包含所有能力模块使用的 SQL 语句

sqls.name: listSkills
sqls.description: 获取技能列表，按创建时间倒序排列
sqls.sql: SELECT uuid, name, nick, description,download, created_at, updated_at FROM skill_store_skills ORDER BY created_at DESC

sqls.name: getSkill
sqls.description: 根据UUID获取单个技能详情
sqls.sql: SELECT uuid, name, nick, description,download, created_at, updated_at FROM skill_store_skills WHERE uuid = $1

sqls.name: searchSkillsByName
sqls.sql: SELECT uuid, name, nick, description,download, created_at, updated_at FROM skill_store_skills WHERE name LIKE $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC

sqls.name: searchSkillsByNick
sqls.sql: SELECT uuid, name, nick, description,download, created_at, updated_at FROM skill_store_skills WHERE nick LIKE $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC

sqls.name: listSkillsByKeyword
sqls.description: 根据关键字搜索技能（名称、昵称、描述）
sqls.sql: SELECT uuid, name, nick, description,download, created_at, updated_at FROM skill_store_skills WHERE name LIKE $1 OR nick LIKE $1 OR description LIKE $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC
